messages:
Eli: Quick postmortem follow-up for PM-3021 (eviction cascade during late-night batch). Need clear owners, JIRA links, and a short RACI for 4 action items. I'll seed suggestions; please ack and update your Jiras by EOD tomorrow.

Rhea: Ack. Can we split immediate mitigations vs observability work? I'll take observability and dashboards.

Omar: I can own the immediate mitigation (temporary threshold bump + small autoscale tweak). ETA: 3 business days. R=Omar, A=Eli, C=Zoe.

Zoe: I'll take the regression harness + CI gating. ETA: PR in 8 days. Need a short acceptance checklist.

Eli: Created PM-3021 and linked issues: REM-4330 (mitigation), REM-4331 (observability + dashboards), REM-4332 (regression harness + CI gate), REM-4333 (postmortem metrics export). Ticket Bot linked them.

Ticket Bot: Created REM-4330, REM-4331, REM-4332, REM-4333 and linked to PM-3021.

Omar: REM-4330 assigned to Omar. I'll add a canary plan and rollback steps; will attach current eviction metrics.

Rhea: REM-4331 assigned to Rhea. I'll add panels for eviction-rate, KV-hit-rate, and a 5m alert when eviction-rate > 0.4%. ETA: 7 days.

Zoe: REM-4332 assigned to Zoe. Will add deterministic repros and require staging pass for 24h before merges. Acceptance criteria: repro runs reliably in CI and gating blocks merges on failure.

Eli: REM-4333 is a short export job to snapshot postmortem metrics into the metrics-repo. R=Eli, A=Product, C=Rhea, I=Zoe. ETA: 5 days.

Zoe: Can we add a ticket-aging rule? Too many PM follow-ups linger. Draft below.

```
Jira Automation:
when: issue created or transitioned
if: status not in (Done, Cancelled) and days since created >= 4
then: add comment "Owner check-in required: update ETA or flag blocker"; set label "needs-owner-review"; notify #postmortems
```

Omar: +1 on automation. I'll include a note in REM-4330 referencing the automation so assignees expect the ping.

Rhea: Also suggesting we tag PM-3021 with label "recurring-pattern" since similar evictions occurred twice in last month. That will help prioritization.

Eli: Hand-off rotation for remediation window: week1 primary = Omar (mitigations), week2 primary = Rhea (observability + validation), week3 primary = Zoe (CI & regression gating). Eli will be backup and approve acceptance. Please update your tickets (owner, ETA, short acceptance criteria) by EOD tomorrow. If you need more time, update the ticket and ping me so we can reassign. :white_check_mark:

Zoe: I'll schedule a 15m sync to review the acceptance checklist once the PR is up. :calendar:

Ticket Bot: Reminder set: please update REM-4330 REM-4331 REM-4332 REM-4333 with owner and ETA by 2026-03-24 EOD or tag @Eli for reassignments.

Eli: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in 48h if any blockers remain.
